# nobus_fos_object (Resource)

An object uploaded to a Nobus FOS container.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "object_source" {
  type        = string
  description = "Path to the local file to upload."
}

resource "nobus_fos_container" "example" {
  name = "terraform-assets"
}

resource "nobus_fos_object" "example" {
  container_name = nobus_fos_container.example.name
  object_name    = "release.tar.gz"
  source         = var.object_source
  source_hash    = filesha256(var.object_source)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container_name` (String)
- `object_name` (String)

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `source` (String) Local file uploaded during creation or update. Optional only to support importing an existing object.
- `source_hash` (String) User-supplied content hash, commonly `filesha256(source)`. Changing it uploads the source again.

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number)
- `content_type` (String)
- `etag` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_modified` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nobus_fos_object.example CONTAINER_NAME/OBJECT_NAME
```
